error: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to redis-cache-01:6379. Connection refused.
root_cause: Redis instance hit max client connections (10000) because the payments-service connection pool was set to 'unbounded' and leaked connections under load spikes.
fix: Set connection pool max_connections=50 in payments-service redis client config, and added a connection timeout of 2s. Restarted redis-cache-01 to clear stale connections.

error: jwt.exceptions.ExpiredSignatureError intermittently thrown for ~15% of requests despite valid tokens.
root_cause: Clock drift between auth-service pods (up to 90 seconds) due to missing NTP sync on newly provisioned nodes, causing premature JWT expiry checks.
fix: Enabled chrony NTP sync in the base AMI and added a 60s leeway to jwt.decode() as a safety margin.

error: psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
root_cause: A deploy left an old version of checkout-api running alongside the new one for 10 minutes, doubling active DB connections and exhausting Postgres max_connections (200).
fix: Added pgbouncer as a connection pooler in front of Postgres, and set deploy strategy to fully drain old pods before starting new ones.

error: kafka.errors.CommitFailedError: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced
root_cause: Consumer processing time for large notification batches exceeded max.poll.interval.ms (300000ms), triggering repeated rebalances and duplicate message processing.
fix: Reduced max.poll.records from 500 to 100 and increased max.poll.interval.ms to 600000. Added idempotency keys to prevent duplicate sends.

root_cause: Elasticsearch cluster went yellow after a node was OOM-killed during a bulk reindex job that wasn't rate-limited.
fix: Throttled bulk reindex to 500 docs/batch with a 200ms delay, and set JVM heap to 50% of node memory per ES best practices.

error: MemoryError: Unable to allocate 2.1 GiB for an array during thumbnail generation
root_cause: A user uploaded a 180-megapixel image that wasn't validated against a max resolution limit, causing the resize worker to OOM.
fix: Added input validation to reject images over 40MP before processing, and capped worker memory with a cgroup limit plus graceful error response.

error: stripe.error.RateLimitError: Too many requests hit the API too quickly
root_cause: A retry loop on failed webhook processing had no backoff, causing a thundering herd of retries against Stripe's API during a partial outage.
fix: Implemented exponential backoff with jitter (base 1s, max 60s) on the webhook retry handler and added a circuit breaker.

root_cause: A long-running analytics query against the primary MySQL instance held row locks on the users table, blocking profile update transactions.
fix: Moved analytics queries to a read replica and added a statement_timeout of 5s on the primary for all non-critical queries.

error: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection termination
root_cause: A canary deploy of checkout-api had a missing health check endpoint, so the gateway routed traffic to pods that weren't ready yet.
fix: Added a proper /healthz endpoint with dependency checks and configured the gateway to wait for 3 consecutive healthy checks before routing traffic.

error: TimeoutError: Model inference request exceeded 5000ms timeout
root_cause: A batch retraining job was running on the same GPU node as the live inference service, starving it of compute during peak traffic.
fix: Moved retraining jobs to a dedicated GPU node pool with taints/tolerations so they can never schedule alongside inference workloads.

root_cause: Recurrence of redis connection issues, this time caused by a noisy-neighbor batch job on the same redis instance running large KEYS * scans.
fix: Migrated the batch job to use SCAN with cursor pagination instead of KEYS, and moved payments-service to a dedicated redis instance.

root_cause: SendGrid rotated their SMTP relay IPs and the service's outbound firewall rule was pinned to old IPs instead of the hostname.
fix: Switched from IP allowlisting to hostname-based egress rules, and added SMTP connection retry with a fresh DNS lookup each attempt.

error: django.db.utils.IntegrityError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint 'inventory_sku_key'
root_cause: A race condition between two concurrent stock-sync jobs from different warehouses both trying to insert the same new SKU simultaneously.
fix: Added an upsert (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) pattern instead of insert-then-check, eliminating the race condition entirely.

error: 429 Too Many Requests from internal rate limiter during login spike
root_cause: A marketing email blast drove a 20x login spike within 2 minutes, exceeding the auth-service rate limiter's burst capacity.
fix: Increased burst capacity with a token bucket algorithm (100 burst, 20/sec sustained) and added horizontal autoscaling triggered by request queue depth.

root_cause: fraud-detection-service's ML model was redeployed with a larger model that increased p99 latency from 200ms to 4s, but checkout-api's timeout was still set to 1s.
fix: Added a circuit breaker with a fallback to a lightweight rule-based fraud check, and set up latency SLO alerts on dependency calls.
